summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine cash dividend payment approved at its April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting and authorized by the Argentine Central Bank. The dividend totals AR$ 69.011 billion, payable in three equal monthly installments of AR$ 23.004 billion each (AR$ 37.544 per share), with record dates and payment dates in June, July, and August 2026. This is an ordinary capital return to shareholders, not an extraordinary special situation. No special-situation classification applies.
